newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Net sales reductions of 5,100 MT resulted as increases for Israel (4,800 MT) and Japan (100 MT) were more than offset by reductions for unknown destinations (6,100 MT) and Mexico (3,900 MT).
Sales of 17,300 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were all for Japan.
Exports of 63,300 MT were down one-quarter from the previous week and the 4-week average. The destinations were Mexico (26,200 MT), Israel (22,800 MT), and Japan (14,300 MT).
